chapter: Massey Hall, race and the record business
title: Fear of Parker, Dizzy, Bud and Max; drugs and manners
summary: Mingus was wary of the bebop circle's drugs and cursing and only came to love Bird later.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road

blocks.x: I was afraid of those guys, because they you know, they were so famous: all used drugs. (Inaudible) Max was a junkie, Bird was a junkie, Bud Powell was a junkie, and Dizzy was crazy. So I was on my toes (inaudible) because I didn't really know their music. Guy insisted I could play it, so -- I never paid no attention to those guys before. "Salt Peanuts, I Got Rhythm, All The Things You Are." (Singing) (Inaudible), I can play that.

I was very little impressed at that time with Charlie Parker and Dizzy, all of them, because I didn't like their manners. They cursed out loud in front of the public, motherfucker, everything. I wouldn't even curse in those days. And as far

as junk was concerned, I didn't know as much about it. But I wouldn't have figured they would turn me on -- if I had come earlier, they might have turned me on, but I couldn't get out earlier. I might have become a junkie myself. I didn't fall in love with the Bird until later, much later.
That's all I'm going to do today, man; (Inaudible), but I'm very tired.
